title: Find Right Interval
description: Find the right interval for each interval i such that start_j >= end_i and start_j is minimized.
pseudocode:
1. Create a map of start points to original indices.
2. Sort the unique start points.
3. For each interval, perform binary search to find the smallest start >= end.
4. If no such start exists, assign -1.

steps.note: Initializing map with start point 1 mapping to index 0.
Looking for smallest start >= 2 for interval [1, 2].
No start point >= 2 found, returning -1 for index 0.
